name: Juventus 2014-19 (Allegri, first spell)
scopeNote: Juventus under Massimiliano Allegri 2014-07-16 to 2019-05-26 (period fixed by the user; dates not re-verified in a mined page). Five Serie A titles, Champions League finals 2015 and 2017. Sources name the shapes as: inherited 3-5-2 (back three Barzagli-Bonucci-Chiellini, BBC), 4-3-1-2 diamond from Nov 2014, 4-4-2/4-4-1-1 defensive block, 4-2-3-1 from Jan 2017 (first v Lazio), 4-3-3 with Ronaldo in 2018/19. The pure-3-5-2 label is wrong for the whole spell and so is a pure-4-2-3-1 label; Allegri alternated by opponent and personnel. Conte-era (2011-14) facts (chain-reaction marking, Pirlo diamond-at-the-back, Terzis data) and Allegri 2021-24 facts (Hudl 5-3-2 piece) were left out as outside the period. Several eventDates are season or month only because the exact match day was not given in the page.
openQuestions: Marking: Spielverlagerung 2016-02 describes zonal marking with small man-orientations vs Bayern and, in May 2016, a 'man-oriented zonal marking system he likes'; no coach-written source on whether this was constant across the five years.

SoccerTutor describes Allegri's 4-2-3-1 with wingers numbered 11 and 7 dropping between the lines, while Coaches' Voice puts Mandzukic on the left and Dybala at 10; the winger assignment is retrospective and unreconciled.
Bonucci's 2024 podcast account of the Feb 2017 Porto exclusion and the Cardiff half-time is one-sided and includes a mobbing accusation; contemporary reports (Football Italia, Goal) were not mined.
Coaches' Voice says the 4-2-3-1 'built on' Khedira/Pjanic with Higuain; the exact date of the Nov 2014 switch to the diamond (Olympiacos/Parma) is month-level only.
Set-pieces: only match-level evidence (Coppa Italia final 2018, Milan 2015 corner concession); no season-level data on set-piece goals or marking at corners (zonal vs man).
Squad-building: Marotta/Paratici buying policy and the 2015 and 2017 sales (Pirlo, Vidal, Tevez, Pogba, Bonucci) only covered by tier C sources.
